questions.question: Phacomelia is caused by ingestion of ......during Pregnancy:
questions.explanation: Thalidomide taken in pregnancy causes phocomelia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: After administration, many drugs are stored at specific locations in the body. What is the primary site for drug storage in the body?
questions.explanation: Adipose tissue is the main depot for lipid-soluble drugs.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Diclofenac sodium is used as an:
questions.explanation: Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Salbutamol is a pharmaceutical agent used as:
questions.explanation: Salbutamol is a selective beta-2 agonist bronchodilator.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient rehabilitating from a myocardial infarction prepares for a graded exercise test. Which of the following pharmacological agents would lower heart rate and blood pressure during an exercise test?
questions.explanation: Beta blockers lower resting and exercise heart rate and blood pressure.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Certain types of drugs such as nitroglycerin can be metabolized and destroyed by the liver. What route of administration would best allow nitroglycerin to each the systemic circulation?
questions.explanation: Sublingual nitroglycerin bypasses first-pass liver metabolism.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Acetaminophen is a commonly encountered drug seen frequently in patients requiring physical therapy. What is the primary benefit of acetaminophen compared to aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medications?

options.D: Decreased irritation of the oral mucosa

questions.explanation: Paracetamol causes less gastric irritation than aspirin and NSAIDs but has little anti-inflammatory action.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient indicates that she is currently taking medication to control high blood pressure. Which of the following classifications of drug would be helpful in the treatment of hypertension?
questions.explanation: Diuretics are a first-line class of antihypertensive drugs.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient is given a prescription for a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory which is to be taken three times a day with meals. What is the most common side effect of nonsteriodal anti-inflammatory medications?
questions.explanation: Gastric discomfort/dyspepsia is the commonest side effect of NSAIDs.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Neurology and Neurosurgery Illustrated/

Medicine/Davidson/5th Ed./Pg. 1090

questions.question: A physician places a patient with moderate hypertension on diuretics. What is the most serious side effect of diuretics? Research and Analysis
questions.explanation: The most serious effects of diuretics are fluid depletion and electrolyte imbalance (e.g. hypokalaemia).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Neurology and Neurosurgery Illustrated/ Medicine/Davidson/20th Ed./Pg. 427

questions.question: A therapist designs an exercise program to increase muscle strength and endurance in a patient rehabilitating from knee surgery. Which type of pharmacological agent would have an atagonistic effect on the desired objective?
questions.explanation: Skeletal muscle relaxants reduce muscle tone and strength, opposing a strengthening programme.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Pharmacological agents can be an important component of a treatment program designed to treat rheumatoid arthritis. Which of the following is not commonly used to treat rheumatoid arthritis?
questions.explanation: Gold, glucocorticoids and NSAIDs are used in rheumatoid arthritis; calcium channel blockers are not.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A physician orders the nursing staff to administer digitalis to patient diagnosed with congestive heart failure. The physician's primary goal using this medication is to:
questions.explanation: Digitalis increases myocardial contractility (positive inotropy) in heart failure.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Hydrocortisone process all of the following properties except:
questions.explanation: Hydrocortisone is not antidiabetic; it raises blood glucose.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: KD Tripthi/Essential Pharmacology/5th Ed./Pg. 254

questions.question: Patients are often placed on diuretics to control high blood pressure and fluid retention. Which of the flowing side effects of diuretics can require immediate medical attentions?
questions.explanation: Diuretics can cause hypokalaemia (potassium depletion), which needs prompt medical attention.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Vol. 1/3rd/Pg. 560
